sentences.en: Can you tell the difference between granite and sandstone?
sentences.zh: 你能区分花岗岩和砂岩吗？

sentences.en: We have sandstone in the bathroom, and parquetry in the bedroom.
sentences.zh: 我们的浴室用的是砂岩，卧室则是拼花木地板。

sentences.en: The name of the Algerian town Tipaza comes from tafza, red sandstone.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚小镇提帕扎的名字来源于塔夫扎，意为红色砂岩。
